subject: Invoice retention window & delivery method decision (portal vs email/SFTP)
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@oakbridge.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ap@oakbridge.com
Date: 2027-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice retention & delivery — what works for Redwood?

Hi Diego,

Hope you’re well — OakBridge AP here. We’re finalizing our vendor onboarding checklist for Redwood and need to confirm two things before we proceed with Coupa mapping:

1) Invoice retention / archival: our audit team requires vendors to retain invoice copies and tax evidence for at least 7 years. Can Redwood guarantee access to generated invoices and associated VAT evidence for that period? If not, what retention window do you support and are there export tools for longer-term storage?

2) Delivery channel: we prefer invoices to be available in our portal (Coupa) but also need email copies to ap@oakbridge.com for immediate processing. Do you support a portal push (API/EDI) + email fanout, or would we need to pick one channel? If portal: what fields are included in the payload (PO#, remit, Tax ID, VAT amount, invoice XML)? If email: can you attach both signed PDF and native XML?

I’ve attached our VAT certificate for reference. Would like to finalize channel and retention by next week to avoid delays on our side.

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Accounts Payable Manager
OakBridge Partners
attachments: VAT_Certificate_OakBridge.pdf

From: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@oakbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Invoice retention & delivery — what works for Redwood?

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and for the VAT cert. Quick answers up front, then a couple of questions so we can lock the integration plan:

- Retention: Redwood retains invoice artifacts (PDF and native XML payloads) for seven (7) years by default for customers in the US and EU. We can provide a periodic archive export (monthly bundle) in case your AP wants to ingest the files into a long-term store.

- Delivery channel: we support a hybrid flow: 1) Portal push (Coupa-friendly XML payload via API or SFTP drop) AND 2) email fanout to your AP mailbox with a signed PDF + attached native XML. Many customers use both so AP can process immediately via email while their ERP ingests the XML.

What we’d need from you to proceed:
- Confirm whether you prefer API push (OAuth endpoint) or nightly SFTP drop for the XML payloads.
- PO number mapping: will Coupa include PO# on the invoice object? If not, we can include both PO and an invoice-reference field.
- Remit-to and tax ID you want printed on the PDF.

We’ll also include automatic Delivery Acknowledgement (an HTTP 200 or SFTP file receipt) and a nightly reconciliation CSV with invoice_id, po_number, amount, and VAT_amount.

Next steps: I’ll loop in Kimberly to scope the payload and Connor for AP integration. If you prefer SFTP we’ll share host + credentials via a secure link; if API we’ll propose an OAuth flow and sample schema.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: sample-invoice-xml-schema.xml

Diego — thanks, that reads well. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- We’d like the hybrid approach: portal push to our Coupa instance (prefer API if available, fallback to SFTP) AND an email copy to ap@oakbridge.com (PDF + XML).
- PO mapping: Coupa will include PO# in 95% of cases, but occasionally AP receives non-PO invoices. Please include an invoice_reference field in the payload for those exceptions.
- Remit and tax: see last page of the attached VAT_Certificate_OakBridge.pdf — our tax reporting team needs Tax ID printed on PDF.

Tech contact for Coupa mapping: Samir Patel (samir.patel@oakbridge.com, +1 415-555-0199). He’ll handle API credentials and can set up an SFTP mailbox if needed.

Please proceed with the API spec and sample payload; Samir will review. We want to run a test ingest next Wednesday (2027-07-07) if possible.

Thanks,
Elena
